rule.name: daily_living_tv_open
rule.description: DL-M04 (activity ledger population, tier 0 / zero model calls). Opens a watching_tv ActivitySession when the TV media_player is on and the resident is present in the TV room. PLACEHOLDERS to replace before import: __RESIDENT_PERSON_ID__ (household_members.id), __TV_ROOM_NAME__ (rooms.name), __TV_MEDIA_PLAYER_ENTITY__ (HA media_player entity id -- must also be set as daily_living.tv.media_player_entity in config/settings.yaml so HaStateCache subscribes to it). Import: POST the four daily_living_*.json bundles in this directory to /api/v1/rules/import (see daily-living-m04-*.md Part E for the full sequence).
